seoTitle: The Boondocks Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Boondocks test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Huey, Riley, Granddad, Tom, Jazmine, Thugnificent or Cindy — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the revolutionary, the hustler or the old-school one who just wants some peace and quiet? Answer 11 everyday questions about money, neighbours and big opportunities, and find out which Boondocks character you are.

characters.name: Huey
characters.title: The Revolutionary
characters.summary: Serious, sharp and never fooled. You see what's really going on, and you're not afraid to say it.
description: Like Huey, you think deeply about the world. He's a 10-year-old genius with strong political views.
You're the voice of reason, even when nobody wants to hear it. Huey narrates most episodes.
You've got hidden depths. Huey speaks Mandarin Chinese, and the show never explains how.
characters.flaw: You're so sure everything will go wrong that you forget to enjoy it when it doesn't.
characters.signature: A raised eyebrow, a book on history and a speech nobody asked for.
characters.clashReason: they'd point out everything wrong with your favourite thing

characters.name: Riley
characters.title: The Hustler
characters.summary: Bold, loud and always working an angle. You act tough, but there's more to you than you let on.
description: Like Riley, you go for what you want. He's a bold 8-year-old who calls himself Young Reezy.
You're always chasing the next opportunity. Riley often ends up in trouble alongside Ed Wuncler III and Gin Rummy.
You've got a softer side you keep hidden. Riley shows real sensitivity in 'Riley Wuz Here'.
characters.flaw: You act tough so nobody sees the softer stuff.
characters.signature: A big plan, a bigger mouth and a talent you keep to yourself.
characters.clashReason: they'd talk you into a scheme that gets you both in trouble

characters.name: Granddad
characters.title: The Old-School One
characters.summary: Practical, proud and in need of some peace and quiet. You've seen it all, and you'd like a nap now.
description: Like Granddad, you've lived a full life. He was a fighter pilot with the Tuskegee Airmen.
You've got stories for days. Granddad says he sat next to Rosa Parks during the Montgomery bus boycott.
You just want a quiet life. Granddad is often embarrassed by his grandsons' antics.
characters.flaw: You'd rather avoid a problem than deal with the noise of fixing it.
characters.signature: A comfy chair, an old story and a request for some peace and quiet.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to keep it down, every single time

characters.name: Tom
characters.title: The Straight Arrow
characters.summary: Careful, polite and strictly by the book. You do the right thing, even when you're nervous about it.
description: Like Tom, you follow the rules. He's a lawyer and a prosecutor.
You play it safe. Tom is strictly law-abiding and easily frightened.
You're braver than you look. Tom eventually faces his biggest fear head-on.
characters.flaw: You worry so much about what could go wrong that you hold yourself back.
characters.signature: A neat suit, a rulebook and a nervous smile.
characters.clashReason: they'd talk you out of anything even slightly risky

characters.name: Jazmine
characters.title: The Believer
characters.summary: Sweet, hopeful and kind. You see the best in people, even when they don't deserve it.
description: Like Jazmine, you believe in good things. She still firmly believes in Santa Claus.
You're kind-hearted and innocent. Jazmine has a childlike trust in the people around her.
You worry, but you keep hoping. Jazmine can get anxious, yet she never stops looking on the bright side.
characters.flaw: You trust people so easily that they sometimes take advantage.
characters.signature: A big smile, a hopeful wish and a heart in the right place.
characters.clashReason: they'd believe every story you know is clearly made up

characters.name: Thugnificent
characters.title: The Star
characters.summary: Loud, flashy and larger than life. You love the spotlight, but you're a good neighbour underneath.
description: Like Thugnificent, you were made for the spotlight. He's a once-famous rapper.
You've had ups and downs. After losing his house to foreclosure, Thugnificent took a job as a delivery man.
There's more to you than the show. Thugnificent has a bachelor's degree in Communications, and he tries to be a good neighbour.
characters.flaw: You care a little too much about looking like a star.
characters.signature: A grand entrance and a story about the good old days.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every quiet night into a full-blown party

characters.name: Cindy
characters.title: The Competitor
characters.summary: Confident, talented and always ready to prove it. You don't just play to win, you play to make a point.
description: Like Cindy, you're seriously talented. She's a gifted junior basketball player.
You've got a big personality. Cindy is cocky and full of attitude.
You don't back down. Cindy can hold her own against anyone on the court.
characters.flaw: You can't let anything go without turning it into a competition.
characters.signature: A trash-talk line, a perfect shot and a victory lap.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a contest they have to win

questions.text: Your friends want to try a new restaurant everyone's hyping up. You...

options.text: Go, but point out it's mostly hype
Go, and invite the whole neighbourhood along
Stay home. There's perfectly good food in the fridge
Get excited, and hope it's as magical as everyone says

questions.text: Someone challenges you to a game you're good at. You...

options.text: Trash-talk the whole way through, then win
Accept, and talk big before you've even started
Politely decline before it gets too competitive
Play, but let them win if they seem upset

questions.text: Someone pushes in front of you at the shop till. You...

options.text: Calmly explain exactly why that's wrong
Mutter something under your breath, and hope they didn't hear
Tell them off, then complain about people today
Let them go ahead with a big smile. You're feeling generous

questions.text: You get some money you weren't expecting. You...

options.text: Spend it on something flashy you can show off
Put it straight into savings
Use it to start a side hustle
Buy little gifts for everyone you love

questions.text: A friend can't figure out something you find easy. You...

options.text: Explain it slowly and carefully, step by step
Offer to do it for them, for a small fee
Help them cheerfully, for as long as it takes
Show them how easy it is for you

questions.text: Your neighbour throws a loud party until 2am. You...

options.text: Put in earplugs, and pray for peace
Report it, following the proper procedure
Head over and join in
Are the one throwing it. Obviously

questions.text: You're asked to give a presentation. You...

options.text: Say no. Nobody would really listen to what you'd say anyway
Wing it with total confidence
Practise until you know every word, and still sweat
Turn it into a big show, with music

questions.text: Someone tells you a story that sounds too good to be true. You...

options.text: Believe every word
Find the hole in it straight away
Ask how you can get in on it
Smile and nod. You've heard taller tales
Nap in your favourite chair
Practise your best sport for hours
Draw or make something you'd never show anyone
Read a book about history or politics

questions.text: You're a lawyer, and your client is obviously guilty. You...

options.text: Do everything by the book, nervously
Refuse the case. You won't defend something you don't believe in
Fight like crazy. Losing isn't an option
Feel sorry for them, and look for the good in them

questions.text: You're a famous rapper, and the money is running out. You...

options.text: Take a delivery job, and get on with it
Sell what you can, and move somewhere cheaper
Turn it into your big comeback story
Challenge a rival to a battle, and take back your crown
